items.exampleEn: A friendly salesperson helped me choose a laptop.
items.exampleZh: 一位親切的銷售員幫我挑了一台筆電。

items.exampleEn: You can order anything in this catalog by phone.
items.exampleZh: 這本目錄裡的東西都可以打電話訂購。

items.exampleEn: Traders from many countries come to this market.
items.exampleZh: 許多國家的商人來到這個市場。

items.exampleEn: The millionaire gave his old house to the city as a park.
items.exampleZh: 那位百萬富翁把他的老房子捐給市政府當公園。

items.exampleEn: The shop window is a showcase for the newest phones.
items.exampleZh: 這個櫥窗用來展示最新款的手機。

items.exampleEn: The shopkeeper knows every customer by name.
items.exampleZh: 店老闆叫得出每位顧客的名字。

items.exampleEn: The pens they handed out were giveaways from a bank.
items.exampleZh: 他們發的筆是銀行送的贈品。

items.exampleEn: Shoplifting is a serious crime in this country.
items.exampleZh: 在這個國家，在商店偷竊是嚴重的罪行。

items.sentenceEn: The shopkeeper put the new bags in the showcase by the door.
items.sentenceZh: 店老闆把新包包放進門邊的展示櫃。

items.audioEn: Every customer who spends over five hundred dollars today will get a giveaway.
items.audioZh: 今天消費超過五百元的每位顧客，都會得到一份贈品。
items.questionZh: 今天消費超過五百元的顧客會得到什麼？

items.sentenceEn: The salesperson showed us the new catalog for spring.
items.sentenceZh: 銷售員給我們看春季的新目錄。

items.sentenceEn: Cameras in the store help stop shoplifting.
items.sentenceZh: 店裡的攝影機有助於防止順手牽羊。

items.stemEn: The ____ sold vegetables at the market for thirty years.
items.stemZh: 那位商人在市場賣菜賣了三十年。

items.stemEn: He sold his small company for a huge amount of money and became a ____ at the age of thirty.
items.stemZh: 他以一大筆錢賣掉自己的小公司，三十歲就成了百萬富翁。

items.passageEn: Mr. Chen has been a shopkeeper in the old market for forty years. When he started, he was a small trader selling tea at a small table on the street. Today, he owns three shops, but he is not a millionaire, he says with a smile. His main shop has a glass showcase full of fine tea sets, and every customer gets a small giveaway, usually a bag of tea. He still prints a paper catalog because many older patrons prefer it. Last year, he hired a young salesperson on an hourly wage to help him sell online. The only problem he has ever had is shoplifting: once, a man tried to hide a box of tea under his coat, but Mr. Chen caught him at the door.
items.passageZh: 陳先生在老市場當店老闆已經四十年了。剛起步時，他只是在路邊擺張小桌子賣茶的小商人。如今他擁有三家店，但他笑著說自己可不是百萬富翁。他的主店有一個擺滿精緻茶具的玻璃展示櫃，每位顧客都會拿到一份小贈品，通常是一包茶葉。他仍然印製紙本目錄，因為很多年長的老顧客比較喜歡。去年，他以時薪請了一位年輕的銷售員幫他在網路上賣東西。他唯一遇過的問題是有人偷東西：有一次，一名男子想把一盒茶葉藏在外套底下，但陳先生在門口抓到了他。

questions.questionZh: 陳先生剛開始做生意時在做什麼？
options: 在網路上賣茶具和茶葉

questions.questionZh: 陳先生為什麼還印紙本目錄？
options: 網路商店常常故障、連不上去
很多年長的老顧客比較喜歡
新請的年輕店員要求他一定要印

items.promptZh: 那位店員很有耐心地回答了我所有的問題。
referenceEn: The salesperson patiently answered all my questions.
That salesperson answered all of my questions with great patience.
rubricZh: salesperson 指店員、銷售員（例如 the salesperson）
「很有耐心地」可寫 patiently、with great patience 等；過去的事用過去式

items.instructionZh: 用 catalog 造一個句子，說說你怎麼用目錄挑選或訂購東西。
referenceEn: I chose a new sofa from the store's online catalog.
I always look through the catalog before I go shopping.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 catalog（例如 the catalog、an online catalog；英式拼法 catalogue 也正確）
句子要說到你自己怎麼使用目錄
